subject: wo-mth
title: WO.MTH.------C.INFO.
description: Second diagram on page 456 (TRF(CW)-28), paired with WO-EXP-PRI x VT-PLT above. The crossing diagrams how world-methodology structurally meets composite-information at the post-WWII bi-aitionalism examination scale: WO-MTH (world methodology) crossed with C-INFO (composite information). WO-MTH sits at left with the subject-arrow; C-INFO at upper-center as partner-axis. TR-INFO (trans-information) upper-left, EXB-G-OR upper-center: EXB-G-OR branches from the main line and carries TR-INFO, from which POL-DY branches. AFI (affinity insight) upper-right, SCI-DY (scientific dynamics), EXT-FT (extended functionalism), PART (participation) on the right. POL-DY (political dynamics) left, APL-DT (application dictates) center. SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) drops from the main line; PRI-INFO (principle information) branches from it and carries LK-IMP (linkage implications), and INFO-DE(B) (information degrees) branches from it and carries APL-DT.
